html:
A Telugu-language action epic of 2022 directed by S. S. Rajamouli, which became a worldwide hit. Its song "Naatu Naatu" won the Academy Award for best original song in 2023, a first for an Indian film production.

The film tells a made-up story about two real revolutionaries of the 1920s, Alluri Sitarama Raju and Komaram Bheem, played by Ram Charan and N. T. Rama Rao Jr. It imagines them as friends fighting British colonial rule in British India, with giant set pieces, wild animals and dance. Its style is unashamedly over the top, drawing on Hindu epics and popular cinema.

It was one of the most expensive and highest earning Indian films. On streaming services it found big audiences in the West, where many viewers met Indian popular cinema for the first time. "Naatu Naatu", composed by M. M. Keeravani with lyrics by Chandrabose, also won a Golden Globe. Some critics in India noted that the film turns history into myth and, at its end, celebrates Hindu nationalist imagery. It belongs to a long line of Indian popular cinema stretching back to Raja Harishchandra and Sholay.
